title: When Apple Terminates Your Developer Account: Crucial Lessons for Young iOS Engineers
description: My Apple Developer account holding 21 original applications was terminated under Section 3.2(f), and the appeal was rejected as final. Here is the unfiltered story and vital warnings for young developers.
content:
# When Apple Terminates Your Developer Account: Crucial Lessons for Young iOS Engineers

> *"Building software is an incredible craft, but depending 100% on a single closed ecosystem is a gamble every engineer must understand."*

In late August 2026, I opened my inbox to an email that every mobile developer dreads:

> **"This letter serves as notice of termination of the Apple Developer Program License Agreement... Pursuant to Section 3.2(f) of the ADP Agreement... Apple has good reason to believe that you violated this Section due to documented indications of fraudulent conduct associated with your account... this decision is final."**

Just like that, an account holding **21 original applications** built over years was terminated overnight. Several of them were widely used utility apps in Uzbekistan with no equivalent alternatives.

I immediately filed a detailed appeal with the App Review Board. However, the final verdict remained unchanged:

> **"After a thorough evaluation, we aren't granting your appeal for reinstatement to the Apple Developer Program. Please note that this decision is final. We won't process subsequent appeals."**

I am writing this not to complain or blame, but to share **unfiltered, practical lessons** with young and aspiring iOS developers so you don't repeat the same mistakes.

---

## 1. What Actually Happened?

My account (Team ID `59VH6CVPK3`) was home to 21 distinct, handcrafted projects:

![App Store Connect - All 21 Original Applications by Azimjon Abdurasulov](/images/asc/app-store-connect-all-apps-hd.png)
*Snapshot from App Store Connect showing all 21 original applications developed and maintained over the years.*

- **Productivity & Utilities:** *Sukun — Breathe. Rest.*, *Talaba*, *Kurs - Yordamchi*, *StorageZen: Phone Cleaner Pro*, *VoxNote: Voice to Text*, *Tashkent Metro*, *DocScan: PDF Scanner & OCR*, *SwipeClean*, *QRia – QR & Barcode Scanner*, *Little World Game*, *FocusFlow - Pomodoro*.
- **macOS Tools:** *Fleet Transfer*, *LocalizeKit*, *ClipMaster*, *WallCamera*.
- **Media Applications:** *OddiyTV*, *StreamNest: Video Browser*, *VeoTV - IPTV Player*, *MoodFlix — Movies & TV*.

Notice the last four apps: **IPTV, Video Browser, and Media Players**.

Even though every single app was developed legitimately without malicious code, media streaming and IPTV players belong to an ultra-sensitive category on the App Store. They constantly face third-party copyright scrutiny, automated crawler flags, and heavy guideline enforcement.

When Apple issued the notice citing **Section 3.2(f)** (Apple’s catch-all clause for alleged "fraudulent conduct"), no specific app or reason was named. 

In my appeal on August 29, 2026, I offered complete transparency:
- I asked Apple to identify the offending app.
- I offered to permanently delete and withdraw all four media apps (*OddiyTV, StreamNest, VeoTV, MoodFlix*) immediately.
- I offered full access to source code, analytics, and verification documents.
- I affirmed under full responsibility that I had never purchased ratings, used review manipulation bots, or deceived users.

Despite this, the appeal was denied without explanation, accompanied by a 1-year ban on reapplication.

---

## 2. Five Critical Lessons for Young Developers

If you are a young iOS developer, an indie builder, or just starting your journey, **take these warnings very seriously**:

### ⚠️ Lesson 1: Media, Streaming & IPTV Apps Are a Danger Zone
If you build video players, IPTV tools, web browsers that stream media, or scrapers, you are walking on a minefield. Even if your player is 100% legal technology, Apple’s automated algorithms and legal teams treat media aggregators with near-zero tolerance. 
> **Rule of thumb:** Do not put experimental media apps on your primary personal developer account.

### ⚠️ Lesson 2: Section 3.2(f) Offers No Second Chances
Normal App Review rejections (metadata issues, UI bugs, minor guideline violations) can be resolved with a quick update. But **Section 3.2(f)** is an account-level death penalty. Apple rarely specifies what caused it, and human appeals to the Review Board have a virtually microscopic success rate once that flag is attached.

### ⚠️ Lesson 3: Never Put All Your Eggs in One Ecosystem
Waking up to find 21 apps wiped out taught me the biggest engineering lesson of my career: **an App Store account is a rented storefront, not your business.**
- Always keep clean, independent Git repositories with comprehensive documentation.
- Diversify your tech stack: master cross-platform technologies (Flutter, React, Node.js, Go) and web development.
- Build direct relationships with your users via websites, newsletters, Telegram channels, and independent brands.

### ⚠️ Lesson 4: Account & Team Hygiene
Be extremely cautious when joining client teams as an Admin, sharing testing devices, or using shared payment methods. Apple tracks network footprints, certificates, and device identifiers. One problematic app or team can compromise an entire developer profile.

### ⚠️ Lesson 5: A Ban Cannot Take Away Your Engineering Skills
Getting terminated hurts deeply after pouring thousands of hours into native Swift and SwiftUI apps. But here is the most important truth:
> **Apple took down the account, but they could not take away the skills, the architectural knowledge, or the ability to solve complex problems.**

Code is code. Great engineers don't stop building because a single platform closed its door. They adapt, branch into backend engineering, explore cross-platform frameworks, launch web SaaS platforms, and come back twice as resilient.

---

## Conclusion: Keep Building

To all the young developers reading this: take care of your accounts, be conservative with App Store compliance, study [Apple's Guideline 5.6 (Developer Code of Conduct)](https://developer.apple.com/app-store/review/guidelines/#developer-code-of-conduct), and never rely on a single distribution platform.

Obstacles are just part of the craft. Dust yourself off, open your editor, and keep building!

ru.title: Блокировка Apple Developer аккаунта: Важные уроки для начинающих iOS-разработчиков
ru.description: Мой аккаунт Apple Developer с 21 оригинальным приложением был заблокирован по Section 3.2(f), а апелляция окончательно отклонена. Реальная история и важные предостережения для молодых разработчиков.
ru.content:
# Блокировка Apple Developer аккаунта: Важные уроки для начинающих iOS-разработчиков

> *"Разработка программного обеспечения — прекрасное ремесло, но стопроцентная зависимость от одной закрытой экосистемы — это риск, который должен осознавать каждый инженер."*

В конце августа 2026 года на мою почту пришло письмо, которого боится каждый мобильный разработчик:

> **"This letter serves as notice of termination of the Apple Developer Program License Agreement... Pursuant to Section 3.2(f) of the ADP Agreement... Apple has good reason to believe that you violated this Section due to documented indications of fraudulent conduct associated with your account... this decision is final."**

В один миг личный аккаунт разработчика, содержащий **21 оригинальное приложение**, создаваемое годами, был заблокирован. Многие из них были полезными утилитами для рынка Узбекистана, не имевшими местных аналогов.

Я немедленно подал подробную официальную апелляцию в App Review Board, но решение осталось неизменным:

> **"After a thorough evaluation, we aren't granting your appeal for reinstatement to the Apple Developer Program. Please note that this decision is final. We won't process subsequent appeals."**

Я пишу этот пост не для жалоб, а чтобы открыто поделиться **практическими уроками с молодыми разработчиками**, чтобы вы не наступили на те же грабли.

---

## 1. Что произошло на самом деле?

На моём аккаунте (`Team ID: 59VH6CVPK3`) находился 21 независимый проект:

![App Store Connect - Все 21 приложение Азимжона Абдурасулова](/images/asc/app-store-connect-all-apps-hd.png)
*Снимок панели App Store Connect со всеми 21 приложениями, созданными за годы работы.*

- **Утилиты и продуктивность:** *Sukun*, *Talaba*, *Kurs - Yordamchi*, *StorageZen*, *VoxNote*, *Tashkent Metro*, *DocScan*, *SwipeClean*, *QRia*, *FocusFlow*.
- **macOS приложения:** *Fleet Transfer*, *LocalizeKit*, *ClipMaster*, *WallCamera*.
- **Медиа-приложения:** *OddiyTV*, *StreamNest: Video Browser*, *VeoTV - IPTV Player*, *MoodFlix — Movies & TV*.

Обратите внимание на последние 4 приложения: **IPTV, видео-браузер и медиаплееры**.

Хотя каждый проект был чистым техническим инструментом без вредоносного кода, категория потокового медиа и IPTV находится под жесточайшим надзором App Store. Они постоянно подвергаются проверкам на авторские права и алгоритмическим блокировкам.

Apple сослалась на **Section 3.2(f)** (общий пункт о мошеннических действиях), не назвав конкретное приложение или причину. В своей апелляции от 29 августа я предложил полную прозрачность: добровольно удалить все 4 медиа-приложения, предоставить исходный код и подтвердить отсутствие каких-либо манипуляций с рейтингами. Тем не менее апелляция была отклонена с запретом на повторную подачу минимум на 1 год.

---

## 2. Пять главных уроков для молодых разработчиков

### ⚠️ 1. Медиа, IPTV и потоковое видео — опасная зона
Даже если ваш плеер на 100% легален, в App Store к этой категории относятся практически с нулевой терпимостью. Никогда не размещайте экспериментальные медиа-приложения на своём основном личном профиле.

### ⚠️ 2. Section 3.2(f) не даёт второго шанса
Обычные реджекты App Review можно исправить за пару дней. Но пометка 3.2(f) — это приговор аккаунту. Причины не раскрываются, а процент успешных апелляций стремится к нулю.

### ⚠️ 3. Не кладите все яйца в одну корзину
Аккаунт в App Store — это арендованная витрина, а не ваш бизнес:
- Храните чистый исходный код в независимых репозиториях.
- Развивайте стек: кроссплатформенность (Flutter, React, Node.js) и веб.
- Создавайте собственную аудиторию вне рамок магазина.

### ⚠️ 4. Гигиена учетных записей
Будьте предельно осторожны со статусом Admin в чужих командах App Store Connect и общими устройствами тестирования. Apple связывает профили по множеству скрытых параметров.

### ⚠️ 5. Блокировка аккаунта — не конец инженерной карьеры!
Apple может закрыть аккаунт, но никто не может отнять ваши знания, архитектурный опыт и умение создавать работающие продукты. Настоящий инженер учится на ошибках, диверсифицирует навыки и возвращается вдвое сильнее.

---

## Заключение
Изучайте правила [Apple Guideline 5.6](https://developer.apple.com/app-store/review/guidelines/#developer-code-of-conduct), берегите свои аккаунты и никогда не сдавайтесь!

uz.title: Apple Developer akkauntim bloklanganda: Yosh dasturchilar bilishi shart bo‘lgan muhim saboqlar
uz.description: 21 ta o‘ziga xos ilovaga ega Apple Developer akkauntim Section 3.2(f) bo‘yicha bloklandi va appeal yakuniy rad etildi. Ushbu maqolada achchiq haqiqat va yosh dasturchilar uchun eng muhim ogohlantirishlar keltirilgan.
uz.content:
# Apple Developer akkauntim bloklanganda: Yosh dasturchilar bilishi shart bo‘lgan muhim saboqlar

> *"Dasturiy ta'minot yaratish — ajoyib san'at, biroq butun faoliyatingizni 100% faqat bitta yopiq ekotizimga bog'lab qo'yish — har bir muhandis tushunishi kerak bo'lgan katta xatardir."*

2026-yil avgust oyi oxirida elektron pochtamga har bir mobil dasturchi eshitishdan qo'rqadigan sovuq xat keldi:

> **"This letter serves as notice of termination of the Apple Developer Program License Agreement... Pursuant to Section 3.2(f) of the ADP Agreement... Apple has good reason to believe that you violated this Section due to documented indications of fraudulent conduct associated with your account... this decision is final."**

Shu tariqa, yillar davomida mehr bilan yaratilgan **21 ta original mustaqil ilovaga** ega bo'lgan shaxsiy Apple Developer hisobim bir kechada yopildi. Bu ilovalarning aksariyati O'zbekiston foydalanuvchilari uchun kundalik qulaylik yaratadigan, bozorda muqobili bo'lmagan foydali loyihalar edi.

Men zudlik bilan Apple App Review Board'ga to'liq va asosli apellyatsiya (Appeal) yubordim. Ammo yakuniy javob o'zgarmadi:

> **"After a thorough evaluation, we aren't granting your appeal for reinstatement to the Apple Developer Program. Please note that this decision is final. We won't process subsequent appeals."**

Men bu maqolani shikoyat qilish yoki kimnidir ayblash uchun emas, balki **yosh dasturchilar va yangi boshlovchi do'stlarimiz** xuddi shu xatolarga tushmasligi uchun ochiq va samimiy tajriba ulashish maqsadida yozyapman.

---

## 1. Aslida nima yuz berdi?

Mening akkauntimda (`Team ID: 59VH6CVPK3`) 21 ta o'z kodi va maqsadi bo'lgan mustaqil dasturlar mavjud edi:

![App Store Connect - Azimjon Abdurasulovning barcha 21 ta ilovalari](/images/asc/app-store-connect-all-apps-hd.png)
*App Store Connect boshqaruv panelidagi yillar davomida yaratilgan barcha 21 ta ilovaning to'liq ko'rinishi.*

- **Foydali ilovalar va vositalar:** *Sukun — Breathe. Rest.*, *Talaba*, *Kurs - Yordamchi*, *StorageZen: Phone Cleaner Pro*, *VoxNote: Voice to Text*, *Tashkent Metro*, *DocScan: PDF Scanner & OCR*, *SwipeClean*, *QRia – QR & Barcode Scanner*, *Little World Game*, *FocusFlow - Pomodoro*.
- **macOS ilovalari:** *Fleet Transfer*, *LocalizeKit*, *ClipMaster*, *WallCamera*.
- **Media ilovalari:** *OddiyTV*, *StreamNest: Video Browser*, *VeoTV - IPTV Player*, *MoodFlix — Movies & TV*.

E'tibor bering: **oxirgi 4 ta ilova — IPTV, video brauzer va media pleerlar**.

Garchi har bir ilovada hech qanday zararli yoki firibgar kod bo'lmagan, barchasi toza texnik vosita sifatida yozilgan bo'lsa-da, media oqimlari (streaming) va IPTV toifasi App Store'da eng qattiq tekshiruv ostidagi soha hisoblanadi. Ular doimiy ravishda uchinchi tomon mualliflik huquqlari shikoyatlari va avtomatlashtirilgan botlar nazoratida bo'ladi.

Apple xatida **Section 3.2(f)** (Apple shartnomasidagi "firibgarlik harakatlari" bandi) ko'rsatilgan bo'lsa-da, aniq qaysi ilova yoki qaysi qadam sabab bo'lgani umuman aytilmadi.

2026-yil 29-avgustda yuborgan apellyatsiyamda men to'liq shaffoflikni taklif qildim:
- Muammoni keltirib chiqargan ilovani ko'rsatishni so'radim;
- Barcha 4 ta media ilovani (*OddiyTV, StreamNest, VeoTV, MoodFlix*) zudlik bilan va butunlay o'chirib tashlashga va bu toifaga boshqa kirmaslikka tayyorligimni bildirdim;
- Barcha manba kodlari, analitika va hujjatlarni taqdim etishga tayyor ekanimni aytdim;
- Hech qachon soxta reyting sotib olmaganimni va foydalanuvchilarni aldamaganimni ta'kidladim.

Biroq, afsuski, Apple hech qanday izohsiz apellyatsiyani rad etdi va kamida 1 yilga qayta ro'yxatdan o'tishni taqiqladi.

---

## 2. Yosh dasturchilar uchun 5 ta oltin saboq (Ehtiyot bo'ling!)

Agar siz iOS sohasiga endi kirib kelayotgan yoki indie-dasturchi bo'lsangiz, quyidagi ogohlantirishlarni qulog'ingizga sirg'a qilib oling:

### ⚠️ 1-saboq: Media, Streaming va IPTV ilovalari — Mina maydoni
Agar siz video pleer, IPTV dasturi yoki videolarni yuklovchi/brauzer ilovalar qilmoqchi bo'lsangiz, o'ta ehtiyot bo'ling. Sizning kodingiz 100% toza bo'lsa ham, Apple bu toifadagi ilovalarga nisbatan shafqatsiz. Ular ogohlantirishsiz butun akkauntni yopib qo'yishi mumkin.
> **Maslahat:** Shaxsiy asosiy dasturchi hisobingizga hech qachon nozik yoki media toifasidagi ilovalarni qo'ymang.

### ⚠️ 2-saboq: Section 3.2(f) — Orqaga yo'l yo'q
Oddiy App Review rad etishlarini (dizayn, tugma xatosi, metadata) osongina to'g'irlab qayta topshirish mumkin. Lekin **Section 3.2(f)** tamg'asi bosildimi — bu akkaunt uchun "o'lim hukmi" kabidir. Apple sababini deyarli aytmaydi va apellyatsiyalarni qayta ko'rib chiqish darajasi 1% dan ham past.

### ⚠️ 3-saboq: Barcha tuxumlarni bitta savatga solmang
Bir kunda 21 ta ilovaning o'chib ketishi menga eng katta muhandislik darsini berdi: **App Store — bu sizning biznesingiz emas, shunchaki ijaraga olingan vitrina.**
- Loyihalaringizning toza manba kodlarini mustaqil Git omborlarida doimo saqlang;
- Faqatgina iOS bilan cheklanmang: Flutter, Web, React, Node.js kabi kross-platforma vositalarini o'rganing;
- O'z foydalanuvchilaringiz bilan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri aloqa kanallariga (veb-sayt, Telegram, ijtimoiy tarmoqlar) ega bo'ling.

### ⚠️ 4-saboq: Jamoa va akkaunt gigiyenasi
Boshqa kompaniyalar yoki mijozlarning App Store Connect jamoalariga Admin bo'lib kirishda, bitta qurilmada bir nechta akkauntlarni ochishda o'ta hushyor bo'ling. Apple tizimlari sertifikatlar, qurilma ID'lari va tarmoq orqali hisoblarni bir-biriga bog'laydi.

### ⚠️ 5-saboq: Akkaunt yopilishi — muhandislikning tugashi emas!
Minglab soat sarflangan loyihalar do'kondan o'chirilganda inson qattiq tushkunlikka tushishi tabiiy. Lekin eng muhim haqiqat shuki:
> **Apple mening akkauntimni o'chirib tashlashi mumkin, ammo ular mening bilimlarimni, arxitektura ko'nikmalarimni va murakkab muammolarni yecha olish qobiliyatimni tortib ololmaydi!**

Haqiqiy muhandis bitta platforma yopilishi bilan to'xtab qolmaydi. Aksincha, u yangi texnologiyalarga, veb-platformalarga va backendga o'tadi, o'z bilimlarini mustahkamlaydi va 2 barobar kuchliroq bo'lib qaytadi.

---

## Xulosa: Rivojlanishda davom eting!

Ushbu maqolani o'qiyotgan yosh dasturchilarga aytar so'zim: App Store qoidalarini ([Guideline 5.6](https://developer.apple.com/app-store/review/guidelines/#developer-code-of-conduct)) chuqur o'rganing, ehtiyotkor bo'ling va hech qachon bitta eshikka bog'lanib qolmang. 

To'siqlar — bu faqatgina yangi va kattaroq imkoniyatlar boshlanishidir. Kompyuteringizni oching va yaratishda davom eting!
